thread:
Asha (product): Quick UX review: transfer/rotate/revoke flows in credential details. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-cred-ux
Mikko (design): Proposed pattern: action menu -> compact modal -> two-column on desktop, stacked on mobile. Show last-used and dependent services.
Renee (backend): API: POST /v1/keys/:id/actions {action: transfer|rotate|revoke, rotate:bool, notify:bool} returns 202 with job id. Note: transfer+rotate should be atomic.
June (content): Copy ideas: primary CTA for rotate = "Rotate secret"; for transfer+rotate = "Transfer & rotate". Warning: "Rotating will create a new secret; update integrations."
Diego (a11y): Modal must trap focus; confirmation for revoke needs keyboard-friendly input for the key name. Use aria-live for job progress.
Mikko (design): Mobile nit: dependent services list under accordion to avoid huge modal. Also add inline help: "What happens on rotate" link.
Renee (backend): Edge cases: key bound to Dedicated infra requires admin approval -> return 409 with message. UI show blocker state and request admin button.
June (content): Empty state when no dependent services: "No linked services found" with CTA "Run scan". Also message when scan pending: "Scanning for usage..."
Asha (product): Ops note: include audit link in success toast. ci-bot will log event: key.action.transfer id=EV-2179991
ci-bot: Job created -> JOB-2179991-3, status=queued
Mikko (design): Action items: I'll update mocks (accordion + compact mobile), @Diego will provide checklist, @Renee to add API error codes, @June will draft microcopy. Review Friday. :thumbsup:
